stories.title: Add Article JSON-LD structured data to blog post pages
stories.description: Implement Article schema markup on blog post pages to improve SEO and enable Google rich results (Article schema with author info, publish/update dates, featured image).
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post pages at /blog/[slug] render Article JSON-LD in <head> with @context, headline, description, datePublished, dateModified, author, and image
Article schema includes articleBody (excerpt), thumbnailUrl, and featured image URL for Google rich snippet display
Validation passes schema.org Article validator and Google Rich Results Test with no errors
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (generateMetadata function to inject Article schema)
File to create: site/src/lib/schemas/article-schema.ts (ArticleSchema class with @type, headline, description, author fields)

stories.title: Implement RSS 2.0 feed endpoint at /feed.xml for blog syndication
stories.description: Create an RSS feed that aggregates all blog posts with title, description, publication date, and author. Enable feed readers and aggregators to subscribe to new blog content.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /feed.xml returns valid RSS 2.0 XML with channel, item, description, pubDate, link, and guid elements
Feed includes all published blog posts sorted by publishedAt descending; limited to first 10 items with <lastBuildDate>
Feed auto-discovers via <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="/feed.xml"> in site/src/app/layout.tsx <head>
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/feed.xml/route.ts (GET handler returning RSS XML from RSS builder utility)
File to create: site/src/lib/rss-builder.ts (buildRssFeed function generating RSS template with blog posts data)
Test command: curl -s http://localhost:3000/feed.xml | xmllint --format - | head -40

stories.title: Create auto-generated Table of Contents component for blog posts
stories.description: Extract H2 and H3 headings from blog post markdown and render a sticky Table of Contents sidebar for navigation. Improves UX, supports WCAG 2.4.5 (Multiple Ways), and reduces bounce rate.
acceptanceCriteria: TableOfContents component extracts H2/H3 headings from blog post and renders with anchor links; clicking link scrolls to heading with smooth behavior
On mobile (<768px), TOC is hidden by default but accessible via expandable toggle button in post header
Active heading is highlighted with visual indicator (border or background color) as user scrolls; highlight updates on scroll event
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/components/TableOfContents.tsx (parse headings from MDX, track scroll position, render sticky sidebar with Intersection Observer)
File to edit: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (extract heading nodes from parsed markdown, integrate TOC on right side)
Test command: npx playwright test tests/e2e/blog-toc.spec.ts --headed (verify scroll tracking and mobile toggle behavior)

stories.title: Add blog post category and tag filtering with dedicated archive pages
stories.description: Add category and tag metadata to blog posts, create /blog/category/[category] and /blog/tag/[tag] archive pages, and implement filter UI. Improves long-tail SEO via faceted navigation and internal linking.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post frontmatter includes categories and tags arrays; /blog/category/[category] renders only matching posts with breadcrumb Home > Blog > Category > [Name]
Tag pages at /blog/tag/[tag] render only matching posts; tag cloud appears on blog index with post counts in parentheses
Blog index page displays category and tag filter UI; filtering works client-side with URL params (?category=food&tag=authentic) without full page reload
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/lib/blog.ts (extract categories and tags from frontmatter, add getCategoryCounts() and getTagCounts() helper functions)
File to create: site/src/app/blog/category/[category]/page.tsx (dynamic category archive page with generateStaticParams for all categories)
File to create: site/src/app/blog/tag/[tag]/page.tsx (dynamic tag archive page with generateStaticParams for all tags)
Test command: curl -s http://localhost:3000/blog/category/food | grep -c '<article' (verify category filtering returns posts)

stories.title: Implement related blog posts sidebar with schema.org IsSimilarTo linking
stories.description: Display 3-4 related blog posts at end of each article based on shared tags/categories. Add isSimilarTo schema.org relations to improve semantic linking and reduce bounce rate.
acceptanceCriteria: RelatedPosts component renders at end of blog post with 3-4 cards showing thumbnail, title, excerpt (100 chars), and publish date in grid layout
Related posts determined by matching tags or categories; posts ranked by relevance score (number of matching tags/categories); exclude current post
Article JSON-LD schema includes isSimilarTo property as array of related post URLs for search engine semantic understanding
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/components/RelatedPosts.tsx (query matching posts by tag/category intersection, render responsive card grid)
File to create: site/src/lib/blog-utils.ts (findRelatedPosts(slug, limit=4) function with tag/category matching and relevance scoring logic)
File to edit: site/src/lib/schemas/article-schema.ts (add isSimilarTo property to Article schema with URL array)
Test command: npx vitest run tests/lib/blog-utils.test.ts (verify findRelatedPosts returns correct matches in relevance order)
